test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some strawberries are oranges.

Some oranges are kiwis.

All kiwis are melons.

**Conclusions:**

I. No strawberry is a melon.

II. All strawberries are melons.

III. Some strawberries are kiwis.

options.text: Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e37e8eb9d7013b4704dac3a7d9ef8e2485010c077b3e462dffaa4bc601d5855f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No strawberry is a melon → Does not follow (As some strawberries are oranges, some oranges are kiwis and all kiwis are melons. So no definite relation is given between strawberry and melon, therefore it is false.)

II. All strawberries are melons → Does not follow (As some strawberries are oranges, some oranges are kiwis and all kiwis are melons. So it is possible but not definite)

III. Some strawberries are kiwis → Does not follow (As some strawberries are oranges and some oranges are kiwis. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
